summary: Tested new Services + Bookings feature and TikTok business-card field end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests passed. Frontend: storefront tabs, booking modal, booking submission, product detail, dashboard orders+bookings section, and Danh thiếp TikTok field all verified.

service_product_crud.details: POST /api/dashboard/products with type='service' creates service; service appears only in ?type=service; product filter excludes services. Legacy products without 'type' field correctly included under ?type=product.

booking_create_public.details: POST /api/shop/fashion-pro-store/bookings returns 200 with booking_id (BK-...) for a valid service_id. Returns 404 when service_id references a regular product or an unknown id.

booking_dashboard_list.details: GET /api/dashboard/bookings returns shop-owner bookings sorted by created_at desc; fields include id, shop_id, service_id, customer_*, preferred_datetime, status, created_at.

booking_status_transitions.details: PUT /api/dashboard/bookings/{id}/status transitions pending->confirmed->completed; invalid status returns 400.

booking_delete.details: DELETE /api/dashboard/bookings/{id} removes booking; second DELETE returns 404.

business_card_tiktok.details: GET/PUT /api/dashboard/business-card returns and persists social_tiktok. Public GET /api/card/fashion-pro-store returns social_tiktok field correctly.

storefront_ui.details: data-testid='storefront-tab-products' and 'storefront-tab-services' both present. Clicking Dịch vụ filters to services only; 'Dịch vụ' badges visible; 2 book-service-{id} buttons rendered.

booking_modal_ui.details: Modal has data-testid='booking-modal' with correct input testids: booking-name-input, booking-phone-input, booking-email-input, booking-datetime-input, booking-note-input and booking-submit-button. Submit POSTs to /api/shop/fashion-pro-store/bookings and shows success toast 'Đã gửi yêu cầu đặt lịch!'. Modal closes after success.

product_detail_page.details: Service product shows data-testid='product-book-service' with label 'Đặt lịch' and opens booking modal; regular product shows data-testid='product-add-cart' with label 'Thêm vào giỏ'.

dashboard_orders_bookings_section.details: Orders tab contains 'Đơn đặt lịch dịch vụ' section (data-testid='bookings-section') with booking-row-BK-*, confirm-booking-*, cancel-booking-*, call-booking-*, delete-booking-* action buttons and 'Chờ xác nhận' status chip displayed.

business_card_tiktok_ui.details: Danh thiếp tab contains data-testid='card-tiktok-input' with placeholder 'https://tiktok.com/@...'. No Instagram input present (replaced).

critical_code_review_comments: Booking email notification reuses send_order_email with booking data packed as an order (customer_address holds service name+datetime). Works but semantically misleading—consider dedicated send_booking_email template.

Public card response only returns keys present in the stored card doc, so if a shop never saved social_instagram the key is absent in the response (not returned as empty string). Frontend must tolerate missing keys (already does). Minor consistency issue.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all UI flows verified for Services + Bookings + TikTok)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_SRV_* service and TEST_PRD_* product in fashion-pro-store during tests (auto-cleaned via DELETE /api/dashboard/products/{id}). Created one booking from the Playwright test (BK-7D682462D73E) which remains in DB as test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Services + Bookings feature fully working. Service products stored with type='service' in db.products; bookings in db.bookings with id 'BK-...'. Storefront URL for fashion shop: /shop/fashion-pro-store. Public card: /api/card/fashion-pro-store. All data-testid attributes confirmed present. If re-running, backend_test: set REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var before pytest.
